messages:
anna-liu: Kicking off prod deploy v1.12.3 in ~5m. Rolling 2 pods at a time, canary -> ramp -> full. @samir-khan can you own smoke/rollback watch? :rocket:
samir-khan: On it, i'll run the smoke script and monitor dashboards. Which metrics should I prioritize?
anna-liu: Priorities: p95 latency <150ms, 5xx <=0.1%, QPS stable, KV-cache hit >=90%, GPU util <85% on dedicated pool. Watch request queue depth and tail traces. Smoke command: `./scripts/smoke_prod.sh --checks basic,logs`. Deploy-bot will post rollout updates.
deploy-bot: Deploy v1.12.3 started — stage 1/3 (20%) rolling. CI run: https://ci.company/deploy/1760664321
olivia: I'll monitor canary traces + logs. If we see decode errors / OOMs -> rollback. :thumbsup:
miguel: Running smoke now from my laptop against canary. quick snippet:
```
OK /health 200
token-gen p50 45ms p95 120ms
errors 0/50
```
posting full results in ~2m.
samir-khan: Smoke run complete: all basic checks passed. p95=118ms, 5xx=0.02%, kv-hit=93%, GPU util ~62%. No error trends. Watch link: https://dashboards.company/prod/overview?run=1760664321 :eyes:
deploy-bot: Stage 2/3 (60%) completed. Stage 3 scheduled in ~2m.
anna-liu: If anything goes red we flip the rollback flag. @sre-oncall please standby for any network toggles. Otherwise continue ramp.
samir-khan: No regressions observed after 10m. Continuing 30m watch but looks stable. Note: increased model-A batch-size 8->10 applied, no perf regression. I'll open a PR to tighten the p95 alert thresholds based on this run.
olivia: Nice — marking observed and leaving monitoring on for the next 30m. :white_check_mark:
